default.label: Before Fieldnote
default.quote: Interviews lived in six different tools. By the time I had tagged them, the decision had already been made.

default.label: First week
default.quote: We imported last quarter’s calls on Monday. On Wednesday the team was arguing about themes instead of opinions.

default.label: Six months later
default.quote: Every product review starts with customer clips now. Research is no longer the step we skip when we are busy.
